notes: VAT standard rate 18% (VAT Act Cap. 406, art. 19(1)). Bullion EXEMPT with credit: Fifth Schedule Part One item 8(2) exempts the supply of investment gold (definition in the Fourteenth Schedule: bars >=995, coins >=900 post-1800 legal tender); imports and intra-EU acquisitions likewise exempt. The Act's gold items are gold-only - silver 18/18. Import duty 0% (EU CN 2026: HS 7108 'Free').

sources.name: Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 406 (legislation.mt official consolidated text), art. 19(1) and Fifth Schedule
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the tax on taxable supplies is 18 percent of the taxable value, and the supply of investment gold is an exempt-with-credit supply under the Fifth Schedule
sources.quote: The supply of investment gold, including investment gold represented by certificates for allocated or unallocated gold or traded on gold accounts and including, in particular, gold loans and swaps, involving a right of ownership or claim in respect of investment gold
